problems.explain: Swap x and y: x = (y − 6)² − 4, so (y − 6)² = x + 4 and y − 6 = ±√(x + 4). f's inputs were x ≤ 6, so f⁻¹'s outputs must be too: y ≤ 6 takes the − sign. So f⁻¹(x) = −√(x + 4) + 6. (The other sign is the inverse of the other half of the parabola.)
